jc.t: Train yatra reaches Poona; the yatra ends via Mumbai

w: Today, more than 10,000 devotees attended the Sunday evening assembly. Swamishri emphasised about service to society, "To be happy in life you have to count the blessings God has showered upon you. And by thinking of those who are suffering, only then can you serve and relieve them of their misery."

Swamishri offered respects at the memorial place of Shri Aurobindo. At 10.10 am Swamishri performed the Murti pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Guru Parampara at the new Swaminarayan Mandir.
At 10.35 am Swamishri visited Akshar Vadi site for the BAPS Cattle Camp project.
Swamishri also visited the dry Veri lake that had been excavated of silt by the local Municipality and NGOs like BAPS. Swamishri sanctified the land by showering holy flowers.
At 5.30 pm the former Chief Minister of Gujarat Keshubhai Patel visited Swamishri and received blessings.

Through the blessings and efforts of Swamishri and the vicharan of sadhus, out of 72 villages in Selvas and Dadranagar Haveli Satsang has spread in 55 villages. After his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the murtis for the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir (hari mandir) in the village of Kudacha.
The evening assembly at the BAPS mandir celebrated Kishore Day. The assembly was themed on “Tamara Snehal Sathvara”, meaning “Your Loving Support”.

A drama written by Jnanratna Swami, “Katha Manavini, Vyatha Manavini”, meaning “The Story of People, the Miseries of People”, was performed by kishores of Nadiad mandal. Thereafter Swamishri was honoured with garlands by senior sadhus. In conclusion, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Leading a life of faith in God affords us happiness and goodness. We find that some people stray due to bad company. One starts drinking and feels very good and becomes oblivious of the world. When liquor influences one in such a way then the power of bhakti to God will also reform you. But, one must have faith and trust in him.”

Today the weather was rather different. In the winter season, clouds had gathered, and because of this unseasonal rain had been falling since early morning. So the cold had become a little more biting. A shawl and cap had been put on Pramukh Swami Maharaj so that the unseasonal rain would not affect him. The assembly hall built outside had become somewhat wet. So it was uncertain whether he would do his puja outside today, but Swamishri himself insisted that he wanted to do the puja outside. Because of this, everyone was able to have Swamishri's darshan today.

After darshan of Thakorji, when Swamishri came to the usual place for his puja, the carpet was already wet. The lawn of the assembly hall and the mats outside were wet too. As soon as Swamishri arrived, all the devotees burst into applause. These devotees, who had been standing until then, began to sit down as soon as Swamishri arrived, without caring about their clothes getting dirty. Outside in the open too, everyone began to sit in the same way. It was as if even the rain saw everyone's devotion and Swamishri's resolve, and it stopped falling just five minutes before Swamishri arrived.
